bullets: The list of starter templates that open in a live preview window grew from two to one hundred and eight.
Closing your terminal window or dropping your remote connection no longer registers as a crash.
The sign-up survey now asks only two questions, which appear as individual steps in the welcome flow.
The Discord member count display was raised from twenty-two thousand to twenty-three thousand.
The in-chat profile survey card has been turned off, so users will no longer see that questionnaire.
The assistant tool now lets a remote program report the user's local operating system to match commands.
The system that decides which ads show up can now tell the difference between desktop and mobile browsers.
The presentation editor now prevents empty section labels and skips blank link titles during replacements.
The assistant can now find every tool offered by an external helper program that lists them in batches.
